_comment_groups: Fill in the two group IDs after running `npm run inspect` once (see README step 3).
_comment_welcome: Sent when someone new joins a managed group. Use {name} for the new member's display name.

welcomeMessage.text: Chào mừng {name} đến với nhóm của Ghiền Tiếng Hàn! 🎉 Hãy đọc ghim (pinned message) để biết nội quy và lịch học nhé.

_comment_keywords: Case-insensitive substring match against incoming group messages. First match wins. Add as many as you want.

keywordReplies.reply: Bạn xem bảng học phí mới nhất tại đây nhé: https://www.facebook.com/ghientienghan22. Cần tư vấn thêm thì nhắn admin ạ!
Lịch khai giảng các lớp được cập nhật tại: https://www.facebook.com/ghientienghan22

_comment_timing: Human-like delay before replying, in milliseconds. A random value in this range is picked each time so replies don't look robotic/instant.
_comment_ratelimit: Safety cap: max auto-replies the bot will send per rolling hour, across all groups. Keeps behavior far from anything that looks like bulk messaging.
_comment_poll: How often (ms) to check each group's member list for new joiners. zca-js doesn't push a reliable join event, so this polls instead. 120000 = 2 minutes; don't set this too low, it's an extra API call per group each tick.
_comment_timezone: Used for all scheduled reminders (reminders.json), independent of what timezone the server/VPS itself is set to.
_comment_reminder_ratelimit: Safety cap: max scheduled reminder messages sent per rolling hour, across all reminders/groups. Guards against a misconfigured reminders.json firing too often.
_comment_toggles: Master on/off switches, editable live from the admin dashboard (or by hand here).
